coordinate_system: ATLAS right-handed coordinates; z along the beam, R=sqrt(x^2+y^2); dimensions in mm
scope_es: Landmarks cilíndricos mínimos del Inner Detector de ATLAS Run 2. Son radios nominales para orientación pedagógica, no una descripción de material ni una geometría de simulación.
scope_en: Minimal cylindrical landmarks of the ATLAS Run-2 Inner Detector. These are nominal radii for teaching orientation, not a material description or simulation geometry.

landmarks.source_note: Figure 1 labels the new Run-2 beam pipe at r=24.3 mm; z extent here is display-only and is not a claimed hardware endpoint.
landmarks.source_note_es: La figura 1 identifica el nuevo tubo de haz de Run 2 en r=24,3 mm; la extensión z mostrada es solo gráfica y no pretende ser un extremo físico.
landmarks.source_note_en: Figure 1 labels the new Run-2 beam pipe at r=24.3 mm; the displayed z extent is graphical only and is not a claimed hardware endpoint.
landmarks.relevance_es: Da una referencia física inmediata para comparar el desplazamiento del DV respecto de la línea del haz.
landmarks.relevance_en: Provides an immediate physical reference for comparing the DV displacement with the beam line.

landmarks.source_note: ATLAS Run-2 pixel barrel radius 33.25 mm; approximate stave coverage |z|~300 mm is documented in ATL-PHYS-PUB-2019-013.
landmarks.source_note_es: Radio nominal del barril pixel de ATLAS Run 2: 33,25 mm; la cobertura aproximada |z|~300 mm está documentada en ATL-PHYS-PUB-2019-013.
landmarks.source_note_en: Nominal ATLAS Run-2 pixel-barrel radius: 33.25 mm; approximate |z|~300 mm coverage is documented in ATL-PHYS-PUB-2019-013.
landmarks.relevance_es: Es la primera capa pixel y fija una escala detectora muy cercana a los vértices desplazados internos.
landmarks.relevance_en: It is the first pixel layer and anchors the detector scale close to inner displaced vertices.

landmarks.source_note: ATLAS Run-2 pixel barrel radius 50.5 mm; approximate outer pixel stave coverage |z|~400 mm is documented in ATL-PHYS-PUB-2019-013.
landmarks.source_note_es: Radio nominal del B-Layer pixel de ATLAS Run 2: 50,5 mm; la cobertura aproximada |z|~400 mm está documentada en ATL-PHYS-PUB-2019-013.
landmarks.source_note_en: Nominal ATLAS Run-2 Pixel B-Layer radius: 50.5 mm; approximate |z|~400 mm coverage is documented in ATL-PHYS-PUB-2019-013.
landmarks.relevance_es: Sitúa un DV interno respecto de la segunda superficie pixel encontrada al alejarse de la línea del haz.
landmarks.relevance_en: Places an inner DV relative to the second pixel surface encountered away from the beam line.

landmarks.source_note: ATLAS Run-2 pixel barrel radius 88.5 mm; z extent is approximate stave coverage from ATL-PHYS-PUB-2019-013.
landmarks.source_note_es: Radio nominal de la capa pixel 1 de ATLAS Run 2: 88,5 mm; la extensión z es la cobertura aproximada de las duelas según ATL-PHYS-PUB-2019-013.
landmarks.source_note_en: Nominal ATLAS Run-2 pixel-layer-1 radius: 88.5 mm; z extent is approximate stave coverage from ATL-PHYS-PUB-2019-013.
landmarks.relevance_es: Aporta una marca radial intermedia para interpretar dónde decae el LLP dentro del sistema pixel.
landmarks.relevance_en: Provides an intermediate radial landmark for locating the LLP decay within the pixel system.

landmarks.source_note: ATLAS Run-2 pixel barrel radius 122.5 mm; z extent is approximate stave coverage from ATL-PHYS-PUB-2019-013.
landmarks.source_note_es: Radio nominal de la capa pixel 2 de ATLAS Run 2: 122,5 mm; la extensión z es la cobertura aproximada de las duelas según ATL-PHYS-PUB-2019-013.
landmarks.source_note_en: Nominal ATLAS Run-2 pixel-layer-2 radius: 122.5 mm; z extent is approximate stave coverage from ATL-PHYS-PUB-2019-013.
landmarks.relevance_es: Marca la capa pixel exterior usada aquí para dar escala, no una condición de aceptación del recast.
landmarks.relevance_en: Marks the outer pixel layer used here for scale, not a recast acceptance condition.

landmarks.source_note: Innermost SCT barrel layer at r=299 mm, spanning |z|<746 mm; especially relevant beside the analysis R=300 mm boundary.
landmarks.source_note_es: Primera capa del barril SCT en r=299 mm y |z|<746 mm; es especialmente útil junto al límite de análisis R=300 mm.
landmarks.source_note_en: Innermost SCT barrel layer at r=299 mm and |z|<746 mm; especially useful beside the R=300 mm analysis boundary.
landmarks.relevance_es: Muestra que una capa física a 299 mm y el límite fiducial a 300 mm son conceptos distintos aunque estén muy próximos.
landmarks.relevance_en: Shows that physical hardware at 299 mm and the 300 mm fiducial boundary are distinct concepts despite being nearby.

landmarks.display_name_es: Corte mínimo del DV: R = 4 mm
landmarks.source_note: Exact boolean analysis boundary R_DV>4 mm.
landmarks.source_note_es: Frontera booleana exacta del análisis R_DV>4 mm.
landmarks.source_note_en: Exact boolean analysis boundary R_DV>4 mm.
landmarks.relevance_es: Separa vértices prompt de vértices suficientemente desplazados para esta selección.
landmarks.relevance_en: Separates prompt vertices from vertices displaced enough for this selection.

landmarks.display_name_es: Límite fiducial del DV: R = 300 mm
landmarks.source_note: Exact boolean analysis boundary R_DV<300 mm. It is distinct from the nearby SCT layer at nominal r=299 mm.
landmarks.source_note_es: Frontera booleana exacta R_DV<300 mm; es distinta de la capa SCT cercana de radio nominal 299 mm.
landmarks.source_note_en: Exact boolean boundary R_DV<300 mm; distinct from the nearby SCT layer at nominal radius 299 mm.
landmarks.relevance_es: Define el alcance radial fiducial del DV modelado por el recast; no representa una capa material.
landmarks.relevance_en: Defines the radial fiducial reach of the DV modeled by the recast; it is not a material layer.

landmarks.source_note: Exact boolean analysis boundary |z_DV|<300 mm.
landmarks.source_note_es: Frontera booleana exacta del análisis |z_DV|<300 mm.
landmarks.source_note_en: Exact boolean analysis boundary |z_DV|<300 mm.
landmarks.relevance_es: Define el alcance longitudinal fiducial del DV junto con R_DV<300 mm.
landmarks.relevance_en: Defines the longitudinal DV fiducial reach together with R_DV<300 mm.

landmarks.source_note: Digitized vertex-efficiency map edge; not detector hardware.

landmarks.source_note_en: Digitized vertex-efficiency map edge; not detector hardware.
landmarks.relevance_es: Indica dónde cambia el bin radial usado para ponderar la respuesta del vértice.
landmarks.relevance_en: Marks where the radial bin used to weight vertex response changes.
